title: Progressive Multi-Site list loading
opportunity: The Multi-Site page waited for the Health summary request before rendering the base Site list, so a slow or unavailable summary made usable Site data appear blank.
implementation: Render the authoritative /api/sites result immediately after it succeeds.
Load /api/sites/health/summary afterward and re-render only when the view generation is still current, preserving stale-request cancellation and explicit loading/unavailable summary states.
Added a regression contract proving base list rendering precedes the summary request.
